## *Acropora cervicornis* transplanted to the Port of Miami {#acerccc-project}

::: {.project-meta}
Ch4 AcerCCC · [<i class="bi bi-github"></i> AcerCCC](https://github.com/ademerlis/AcerCCC) · [Frontiers in Marine Science (2026)](https://doi.org/10.3389/fmars.2026.1796814)
:::

Gene expression patterns in *Acropora cervicornis* following transplantation from an offshore nursery to a marginal, nearshore environment in the Port of Miami.

::: {#acerccc}

## Stress-Hardening {#stresshardening-project}

::: {.project-meta}
Stress-Hardening (includes Temperature Variability 2023 and Ch2 Temp Variability) · [<i class="bi bi-github"></i> temperaturevariabilityAcerPcli](https://github.com/ademerlis/temperaturevariabilityAcerPcli) · [Ecology and Evolution (2025)](https://doi.org/10.1002/ece3.72108)
:::

Gene expression and physiological responses of *Acropora cervicornis* and *Pseudodiploria clivosa* to a variable thermal priming treatment.

::: {.project}
## *Pseudodiploria strigosa* reciprocal transplant {#rt-project}

::: {.project-meta}
Reciprocal Transplant · [<i class="bi bi-github"></i> reciprocaltransplant](https://github.com/ademerlis/reciprocaltransplant)
:::

A reciprocal transplant experiment with *Pseudodiploria strigosa* between an urbanized, thermally variable inshore site (MacArthur Causeway North, Port of Miami) and an offshore reef (Emerald Reef).

::: {#rt}
:::
